scope_limits: Only model input is rewritten; persisted conversation/state is left as-is (comment, line 286).
Payload size is approximate ((len(b64) * 3) // 4 of the base64 string), not an exact decoded byte count (lines 311-315).
Only messages whose content is a list are inspected; messages with non-list content pass through unchanged (lines 327-330).
Detection is limited to block types in _ATTACHMENT_BLOCK_TYPES and image_url blocks with data: URIs (lines 289-292, 303-310); other carrier shapes are not measured.
Attachments at or under the limit pass through untouched (lines 285, 350-351).

EmptyResponseGuard is registered in the same middleware list (line 408) but retries empty completions (no text, no tool calls); it imposes no attachment-size condition and is excluded from this obligation.
